            }
        }
    }
    'actionButtons' = $actionButtons
    'OnResult' = {
      # Load the existing XML file
      
      $XMLFile = $null
      $XMLFile = $PowerControl.JsonCache.files | Where-Object {$_.name -eq $GUIResults.File.Content}
      
      if($null -eq $XMLFile) {
        $xmlContent = @"
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<Engine>
</Engine>
"@
        New-Item -Path $PowerControl.General.enginePath -Name $GUIResults.File.Content -ItemType File -Value $xmlContent -Force | Out-Null
        $xmlPath = $PowerControl.General.enginePath + '\' + $GUIResults.File.Content
      }
      else {
        $xmlPath = $XMLFile.path
      }          
      
      $xmlDoc = New-Object System.Xml.XmlDocument
      $xmlDoc.Load($xmlPath)

      # Find the Engine element
      $engineElement = $xmlDoc.SelectSingleNode("/Engine")

      if ($engineElement -eq $null) {
          Write-Error "Engine element not found in the XML file."
          return
      }

      # Create the PCtrl element
      $pctrlElement = $xmlDoc.CreateElement("PCtrl")
      $engineElement.AppendChild($pctrlElement) 2>&1 | Out-Null

      # Set attributes for PCtrl
      $pctrlElement.SetAttribute("type", $GUIResults.Type.Content)
      $pctrlElement.SetAttribute("Label", $GUIResults.ElementName)
      
      $RndID = $($(New-Guid)).ToString("N")
      $modLabel = $($(Get-Culture).Textinfo.Totitlecase($GUIResults.ElementName) -replace "[,:?#_(). -]",$null)
      $pctrlElement.SetAttribute("ID", $($modLabel.Substring(0,$(if($modLabel.Length -gt 25){25}else{$modLabel.Length})) + '-' + $RndID).Substring(0,32))

      if ($GUIResults.Children -and $GUIResults.Children.Count -gt 0) {
          $childrenIDs = @()
          foreach ($child in $GUIResults.Children) {
              if ($child.Content -match '-\s*(\S+)$') {
                  $childrenIDs += $matches[1]
              }
          }
          if ($childrenIDs.Count -gt 0) {
              $pctrlElement.SetAttribute("Children", $childrenIDs -join ',')
          }
      } else {
          $pctrlElement.RemoveAttribute("Children")
      }

      $iconValue = if ($GUIResults.Icon -is [string]) { $GUIResults.Icon } elseif ($null -ne $GUIResults.Icon) { [string]$GUIResults.Icon.Content } else { '' }
      if ($iconValue) {
          $pctrlElement.SetAttribute("Icon", $iconValue.Replace($PowerControl.General.CurrentPath + '\icons\', $null))
      }
      
      if ($GUIResults.Description) {
          $descriptionElement = $xmlDoc.CreateElement("Description")
          $descriptionElement.InnerXml = "`n<!--`n" + $GUIResults.Description + "`n-->`n"
          $pctrlElement.AppendChild($descriptionElement) 2>&1 | Out-Null
      }
      
      if ($GUIResults.ToolTip) {
          $pctrlElement.SetAttribute("ToolTip", $GUIResults.ToolTip)
      }
      
      # Create DisplayCondition element if Category or SortOrder is provided
      if ($GUIResults.DisplayCondition) {
          $displayConditionElement = $xmlDoc.CreateElement("DisplayCondition")
          $pctrlElement.AppendChild($displayConditionElement) 2>&1 | Out-Null

          if ($GUIResults.Category) {
              $displayConditionElement.SetAttribute("Categorie", $GUIResults.Category)
          }

          if ($GUIResults.SortOrder) {
              $displayConditionElement.SetAttribute("SortOrder", $GUIResults.SortOrder)
          }

          $cdataSection = $xmlDoc.CreateCDataSection("`n" + $GUIResults.DisplayCondition + "`n")
          $displayConditionElement.AppendChild($cdataSection) 2>&1 | Out-Null
      }
      
      if ($GUIResults.key) {
          $keyBindingElement = $xmlDoc.CreateElement("KeyBinding")
          $pctrlElement.AppendChild($keyBindingElement) 2>&1 | Out-Null

          $keyBindingElement.SetAttribute("Key", $GUIResults.key)
          $keyBindingElement.SetAttribute("Modifiers", $GUIResults.Modifiers.Content)
      }
      
      # Create Script element
      $scriptElement = $xmlDoc.CreateElement("Script")
      $pctrlElement.AppendChild($scriptElement) 2>&1 | Out-Null
      $cdataSection = $xmlDoc.CreateCDataSection("`n" + $GUIResults.Script + "`n")
      $scriptElement.AppendChild($cdataSection) 2>&1 | Out-Null

      # Save the modified XML back to the file
      Save-PowerControlXml -XmlDocument $xmlDoc -Path $xmlPath -RefreshIndex
    }
}
